description: Today, Assembly Minority Leader Ed Ra welcomed the Long Island Federation of Labor President John Durso as part of the Italian American Day celebration at the Capitol. The New York Conference of Italian American State Legislators hosts the annual event to promote and celebrate Italian culture, fellowship and traditional Italian food and festivities. title: ASSEMBLY MINORITY LEADER RA WELCOMES PRESIDENT OF LONG ISLAND FEDERATION OF LABOR JOHN DURSO TO CAPITOL
